name: Mille Lacs Kathio State Park, Ogechie Campground
waterfront_evidence: ReserveMN facility 791 (Ogechie Campground) lists 'Lake/River/Creek: .4 mile' for every one of its 25 units (read 2026-11-11). Unit centroid 46.14355,-93.77126; the westmost sites (1-4, west edge about -93.7725) are about 210 m from the marsh fringe and about 370 m from the open water of Ogechie Lake on Esri World_Imagery (46.1436,-93.7765, half-width 600 m), with closed forest between. The DNR inset map (Inset A) draws the loop in woods east of the lake with no shoreline sites. Not waterfront.
inclusion_evidence: DNR park record spk00232 (read 2026-11-11): 'The park has a total of 70 secluded and shaded drive-in sites ... 26 rustic sites are one and one-half miles from the shower building, with vault toilets and water nearby.' ReserveMN PlaceId 107, facility 791 'Ogechie Campground': 25 web-bookable units named 'Drive-In #1' to 'Drive-In #26' (no #14 online), each 'Standard Back In', 'Parking Pad Type: Gravel', 'Parking Pad Width: 10', 'Pad Length: 30', 'Rustic Site. No slide out on left.', $23 a night (site 11 a double at $46), in season 2026-04-18 to 2026-11-01. The DNR park map (files.dnr.state.mn.us/maps/state_parks/spk00232.pdf, Inset A) shows the loop on its own branch road off the park road ('to ranger station 3 Miles'; 'to parking & historical sites'), separate from Petaga Campground, whose unit centroid (46.12722,-93.76931) is 1.82 km south on another branch. A 23-ft rig fits a 30-ft back-in pad with no left-side slide-out.
note: Rustic wooded loop near Ogechie Lake and the park's historical sites, about 1.5 miles from the shower building at Petaga Campground; the dump station is about 3 miles away. Pads are listed at 30 ft with no room for a left-side slide-out. --Claude

sites.note: All back-in gravel pads listed at 30 ft by 10 ft; no left-side slide-out. Site 11 is a double site.

season.note: Bookable from mid-April (April 16 in 2027) to November 1; the loop road is closed in winter.

fees.note: Rustic site $23 a night; the double site 11 is $46.
